hint.en: Where the assistant's spoken reply is played. "Play on this device" uses the built-in speaker. "Send to a Flow as a URL" plays nothing here and instead fires the "Reply audio is ready" Flow trigger with a link to the audio, so another speaker can play it — useful when this device has no speaker, or when a better one is in the room. The reply is not spoken until it is fully generated, so expect a little more delay than playing it here.

label.en: Send to a Flow as a URL
